newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar's QNGC appoints new vice-chairman.
newsitem.headline: Qatar's QNGC appoints new vice-chairman.

text.p: Qatar's Emir reshuffled the board of Qatar General Petroleum Corporation (QGPC) on Wednesday, appointing a new vice chairman to the state oil and gas firm.
A decree from Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani appointed Yousef Hussein Kamal, an undersecretary at the Doha Ministry of Finance, Economy and Commerce, as QGPC's new vice-chairman.
Minister of Energy and Industry Abdullah bin Hamad al-Attiyah was retained as chairman and managing director.

Faisal Mohamed al-Suweidi, Hamad Rashid al- Muhannadi, Abdullah Salatt, Nasser Mohamed al-Mansouri and Ibrahim Butros al-Ibrahim were also appointed members, raising the number of the board's members to seven from six.
